title: Network CSV rerun end-to-end validation
summary: Phase 8 validates the Network CSV rerun coordinator-to-worker-to-reducer flow end to end with isolated state and representative real-media evidence.
reason: Phases 4A through 7 built Network CSV rerun state, claim execution, reduction, destination policy, and WebView surfaces. The feature now needs an end-to-end safety gate proving coordinator authority, worker-only claims, restart/duplicate-claim behavior, destination evidence, and unchanged source hashes before release hardening.
behavior_before: Network CSV rerun phases have targeted unit, route, WebView, and representative per-phase real-media evidence, but no single Phase 8 gate ties coordinator start, worker claim/execution, reducer, destination policy, restart behavior, and source preservation together.
behavior_after: A documented Phase 8 validation gate proves or records gaps for the full Network CSV rerun flow using backend-owned state and isolated media roots, with any required fixes covered by focused tests and evidence.
tests_added: tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_process_launch: Phase 8 full Network CSV rerun state flow from confirmed batch start through claim, duplicate block, release/reclaim, done, Pending Publish destination policy, source-hash preservation, terminal no-reclaim, and read-model projection
manual_validation: PASS: Phase 8 retained real-media validation using Phase 4B source and real worker output; evidence in docs/RealMediaValidationRuns/network-csv-rerun-phase8-2026-07-06.md and retained summary <local temporary retained-summary path, redacted>
rollback_plan: Remove Phase 8 validation-only docs/tests/harness changes or revert any focused fixes introduced by this packet. Preserve all real-media evidence records and do not delete source media, handoff outputs, Pending Publish payloads, or final-library outputs during rollback.
notes:
Phase 8 scope: validation and release-gate hardening for the already built Network CSV rerun path. Prefer isolated temporary LocalBase, handoff, scratch, output, and final roots; do not use operator library roots for destructive checks.
D1 proof target: exercise coordinator-owned Network CSV rerun batch start, worker claim, worker execution/handoff, worker done, coordinator reducer, destination-policy application, read-model projection, and WebView-readable evidence in one trace where feasible.
D2 coordinator-only proof: lifecycle start and network batch start must not process local files unless local-worker mode is explicitly configured; confirmed start writes only backend-authorized network rerun state.
D3 worker-only proof: workers claim only coordinator-assigned csv_rerun_row work, use job-scoped config rewrites, write only to NetworkRerunHandoffRoot row folders, and never write final library destinations or accepted Pending Publish ownership.
D4 source safety proof: capture source hashes before and after worker/reducer/destination steps; fail the phase if any source media changes, moves, or disappears.
D5 restart/duplicate proof: simulate stop-after-current or crash/restart at state level where possible and prove rows do not duplicate claims, can continue pending work, and preserve row evidence.
D6 remote/path-map proof: validate path mapping and UNC/shared-root assumptions with fixture-backed remote-worker mapping when no second physical worker is available; call out any remaining physical remote-worker gap explicitly.
D7 destination proof: verify Pending Publish/final replacement/review evidence matches local CSV rerun trust standards, including destination_policy_result, manifest paths, sidecar/hash/size evidence, and backend read-model projection.
D8 validation rung: targeted unit/integration tests plus real-media evidence document under docs/RealMediaValidationRuns/. Stop if proof requires workers to write source/final roots, frontend-authored policy, broad SMB writes outside NetworkRerunHandoffRoot, unstable source identity, unpreventable duplicate claims, or reinterpreting -DryRun.
